name: LitWatch
description: LitWatch watches your Lighter accounts around the clock and alerts you on Telegram the moment something drift.
longDescription:
An operations monitor for Lighter traders and their bots.
Connect a Lighter read-only token—it cannot trade or withdraw, and we never hold trading keys. Get Telegram or webhook alerts when margin or liquidation distance becomes dangerous, orders are rejected or appear stuck, a bot goes quiet, rate limits are hit, or Lighter itself has an outage.
